model: L2 residual around log market probabilities; binary player-swap augmentation and symmetrised prediction
nonfinite_features: zero, fixed neutral prior, not learned using evaluation data

feature_rules.football: 19 prior-day baseline descriptors; enriched adds last3 versus last10 form, goal and target differences, goals-minus-0.3-targets proxy, previous-market result surprise, 14-day workload and nonlinear market interactions; not actual xG
feature_rules.atp: Rebuild prior-day states on Tennis-Data actual match dates, coherent B365 prices. Attach rich match statistics on unordered canonical name pair, year and round, within 14 days, only unique one-to-one candidates, independently of winner. Baseline structural, enrichment serve-return and surface/pace interactions plus sample-confidence and fatigue interactions. Never use inherited average odds as bet prices.
feature_rules.ufc: Prior-date baseline Elo, experience, recent win rate, age, layoff; enrich lagged striking/grappling/control/knockdowns, experience-weighted reliability, market disagreement and nonlinear age/layoff interactions. No stance or current profile performance rates. No evaluation of 2025 onward.

odds: football B365 pre-closing 1X2; ATP B365 coherent pair; UFC legacy paired quotes of unverified bookmaker/timing
fit: Annual Jan1 fit, completed training results strictly before Jan1 minus7days; all model preprocessing train-only
model_choice: Lowest pooled development log-loss, ties use candidate order; never evaluation returns
threshold_choice: On tuning years only, maximise 95pct bootstrap lower ROI bound for fixed staking among thresholds with at least50settled bets; tie prefers lower threshold. If none, freeze 0.02 as diagnostic but mark tuning_failed.
secondary_staking: quarter_kelly diagnostic only; not selected after evaluation
settlement: Noncompleted ATP and nondecisive UFC void, retained in selection and potential exposure. Operator-specific settlement not verified.

uncertainty.method: circular3month blocks; 3sports*4models*3thresholds*2stakes; does not cover earlier research

research_gate: tuning passed, >=200 settled evaluation bets, positive ROI at2and5pct haircut, family-adjusted lower>0, >=2of3positive evaluation years, positive without best profit year. This is not an authorisation to bet.
limitations: Quotes not demonstrably simultaneous or executable in France
Source calendar dates do not establish exact end times
Historical stat/profile revisions are not point-in-time archives
No invented injuries, xG or current-match descriptors
No paid data or live bets
